encounter: P12 play_order 142, E0168 TRAINER_MARY (Petalburg Gym room 5 - the price of power), cap 42
availability_audit: Petalburg Gym is challenged in C27; cap 42 until Norman's badge at the end of the Gym. No Surf. Every member is in work/reference-pools/pool-42.json with gate <= 42 and a source map walked by C26. Gardevoirite stone-window 14; Mega Ring from Steven in C13. Route 118 and New Mauville sources excluded. No legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast or Paradox species.
plan: Mary's crack list names Fairy, Fighting, Fire into Bewear, and Rocky Helmet. This party leans on Fairy and Fire. Mega Gardevoir's Pixilate Hyper Voice is 2x into Drampa, Obstagoon, Bewear and Mega Lopunny at once, and Gardevoir resists Fighting at 0.25x, which matters because four of the six carry a Fighting move. Mystical Fire and Flamethrower are the Bewear answer specifically - Fluffy doubles Fire damage taken, so a resisted-looking Fire attack is actually the hardest hit available against it. Incineroar's Knock Off is the disruption piece: removing Obstagoon's Flame Orb before it activates denies Guts and the Facade doubling in one action, and it also takes Rufflet's Eviolite and Dudunsparce's Leftovers. Togekiss takes High Jump Kick, Close Combat and Drain Punch at 0.25x and its Air Slash is 2x into both Normal/Fighting bodies. Declared in advance: Mega Lopunny's Scrappy means Chandelure's Ghost typing does NOT blank its Fighting and Normal moves, so Chandelure is not a safe answer to the ace.
